about: Lines written to an AI (addressed) and lines that only mention one (mentionOnly, mentionOnlyReal), for the addressedToAi reader of the requirements excerpt (supabase/functions/agent-mcp/posting-excerpt.ts). addressed and mentionOnly were written for this corpus on 2026-11-17 in the shapes employers and injected text use: the first 150 and 123 before the reader was changed, the last 40 of each afterwards as a holdout, which the changed reader then flagged 35 of 40 and 0 of 40 on, and was changed again to flag all 40. fromReview holds the lines a review of the first version tried that are not already above. mentionOnlyReal are lines of real postings already in this repo's fixtures that name AI, an assistant, a model or a bot, each named by its fixture and row. fromSecondReview holds the 40 lines written to an AI and the 40 that only mention one that a second review wrote on 2026-11-17 after reading the patterns: the reader then flagged 17 of the 40 and 10 of the mention-only lines, and was changed to flag 40 and 0. They are tuned on, like the rest of this file; posting-lines-to-an-ai-holdout-2026-11-17.json holds lines no pattern was changed for.
